# Academic Research Suite vendored material

This directory contains the unmodified role prompts and workflow entry points
used by `research-direction-debate`. It is intentionally a focused subset, not
a full copy of Academic Research Suite.

- Source adapter: `academic-research-suite` for Codex, adapter version `0.1.21`
- `academic-research-skills`: https://github.com/Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.git
  at `bbc0659272a511b422f6856cd6f44b6ccb2ac213`
- `experiment-agent`: https://github.com/Imbad0202/experiment-agent.git
  at `9b063fa895eaf1f63ac99ac03f924f8d31aa8d26`
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International
  (`LICENSE`)

Attribution: Cheng-I Wu / Academic Research Skills contributors. Preserve this
notice and `LICENSE` when redistributing the plugin. This plugin's local role
contracts may constrain the bundled prompts; they never grant additional tool,
network, model-dispatch, or file-write authority.
